assignments.decisiveDefect: participant-instructions.md carries none of this route's 13 committed selfHelpStopConditions, and it affirmatively contradicts one of them. The registry's first condition is an express hard stop for non-citizens - the Utah Courts self-help page itself tells non-citizens to consult an immigration lawyer before expunging, because the FBI may retain records of an expunged case - and the packet never mentions immigration, citizenship, a lawyer, an attorney or counsel anywhere in the file. The registry's second condition is that self-help ends when the prosecutor or a victim objects or the court schedules a hearing; the packet instead tells the participant 'The prosecutor or a victim in your case may object; if the court schedules a hearing, attend it', directing self-representation at the exact point the route's own record says to stop.

SELF_HELP_STOP.whatIsWrong: Zero of 13 selfHelpStopConditions and zero of 16 selfHelpBoundaries from data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json track ut_pet_conviction appear in participant-instructions.md. A keyword scan of the whole file returns 0 occurrences of 'lawyer', 'attorney', 'immigration', 'citizen' and 'counsel'. Missing in particular: the non-citizen hard stop; the objection-or-hearing stop, which is contradicted rather than merely omitted; the 77-40a-303(4) and (5) conviction-count limits that run on total criminal history across all states including previously expunged cases; the 77-40a-303(6) mixed-episode counting rule; whether an offence is a violent felony under 76-3-203.5(1)(c)(i); which of case closure, release or termination of supervision starts the waiting period; BCI offering a special certificate instead of a certificate of eligibility, which moves the eligibility decision to the court; an active protective order or stalking injunction; expunging appellate records; and the public-interest showing that has to be argued rather than simply stated - which matters here because the packet already leaves that explanation blank for the participant to write.
SELF_HELP_STOP.whereToFix: data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/ut/ut-pet-conviction-set--official-pdf-fill/participant-instructions.md, and the builder that emits it.
SELF_HELP_STOP.whatGoodLooksLike: The sibling packet in this same wave, wv_conv_multiple_misdemeanors-set, does this correctly: it carries a 'Where self-help ends' section reproducing all ten of its route's selfHelpStopConditions word for word, cites the exact file, track and field so a reader can check it, escalates the immigration item to an express hard stop, and separates the two post-filing stops with the instruction to look for a lawyer as soon as an opposition is served. The input is available and the pattern is established; this is an omission, not a blocked legal input.
SELF_HELP_STOP.evidence: legal-design-track-registry.json track ut_pet_conviction selfHelpStopConditions (13) and selfHelpBoundaries (16); participant-instructions.md line 40 and full-file keyword scan

assignments.decisiveDefect: The packet does not state where self-help ends, and in particular never states the committed track registry's first recorded self-help stop condition for pa_pardon_expungement: "The participant has not yet obtained a pardon; the pardon application itself is out of scope and is a referral."
assignments.whyItMatters: That condition is the entry condition for the whole route. A participant who has not obtained a pardon is not eligible for anything in this packet, and the packet is the only place they learn what the route needs. As built it would have them fill seventy-eight blanks, order a Pennsylvania State Police criminal history within a 60-day window, and pay a county filing fee reported at roughly $132 to $215, for a petition that cannot succeed. The build's own findings file shows the builder knew the conditional-versus-unconditional question was 'a self-help limit' and chose to state the difference in terms; the not-yet-pardoned case was not carried over at all.

registrySelfHelpStopConditions: The participant has not yet obtained a pardon; the pardon application itself is out of scope and is a referral.
Whether the pardon is conditional or unconditional cannot be determined from the document.
The record still appears after the quarterly cycle and the fallback route's availability is unclear.

statedInThePacket.condition1_notYetPardoned: NOT STATED anywhere. The five rendered pages use the word 'pardon' three times and all three are route labels: the guidance page's 'Route: Expungement Following an Unconditional Pardon' and the two printed route keys. participant-instructions.md never raises it.
statedInThePacket.condition2_conditionalVsUnconditional: APPROACHED, NOT STATED AS A STOP.
